run_FF_analysis: run the FF_analysis module to generate force field vs DFT error plots and MAE statistics
create_get_data: create a function to load JSON data and extract DFT and FF interaction energies for CO2 and H2O
build_binned_average: build a function to compute average prediction errors within user-defined energy bins
test_phys_err: test the physisorption error calculation by computing MAE for DFT energies between 0 and -0.5 eV
review_get_Fig4a: review the get_Fig4a function that generates a histogram of raw FF vs DFT error distributions
